description: SISTERS, OR- Today, Deschutes County Commissioner and candidate for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District, Patti Adair, condemned Congresswoman Janelle Bynum for voting against the Stop Insider Trading Act. Commissioner Adair stated the following: “Since I announced my campaign in November, I have heard from voters in every part of this district.
